data.name: Riswana
data.gender_notes: Riswana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A blooming garden or blooming flowers. The name Riswana carries the meaning “Garden, bloom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Riswana usually hope their child will grow to embody garden, bloom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Representing the beauty of nature and the blessings of Allah SWT in our lives
data.etymology: Riswana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden, bloom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Riswana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ريسوانة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الرفعة و العزة في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: ريسوانة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ر-س-و' الذي يحمل معاني الرفعة و العزة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخصية التي تتمتع بالكرامة و الرفعة في المجتمع. و يرتبط هذا الاسم بصفات مثل الشرف و العلو.

in_urdu.name: ریسوانہ
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا نام جو اسلامی تعلقات میں عزت و رفعت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریسوانہ نام عربی جڑ 'ر-س-و' سے نکلا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں عزت، رفعت اور شرافت۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو معاشرے میں اعزاز و احترام کی نگاہ سے دیکھے جاتے ہیں۔ اس نام کے روحانی معنی ہیں کسی کی اپنی ذات میں عزت و وقار کو برقرار رکھنا۔

in_hindi.name: रिसवाना
in_hindi.meaning: एक ऐसा नाम जो इस्लामी संबंधों में गरिमा और सम्मान की ओर संकेत करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: रिसवाना नाम की उत्पत्ति 'र-स-व' अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है गरिमा, सम्मान और प्रतिष्ठा। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इस नाम का उपयोग उन व्यक्तियों के लिए किया जाता है जो समाज में गरिमा और सम्मान के साथ रहते हैं। इस नाम का आध्यात्मिक महत्व है अपनी व्यक्तिगत गरिमा और सम्मान को बनाए रखना।

in_pashto.name: ریسوانہ
in_pashto.meaning: د عزت او ویاړ په اسلامي اړیکو کې اشاره کوونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ریسوانہ نوم د 'ر-س-و' عربي ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د عزت، ویاړ او شرافت معنی لري. په افغان او پښتني دود کې، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې په ټولنه کې د عزت او ویاړ سره ګوري. د دې نوم روحاني معنی د خپل ذات په عزت او وقار کې پاتې راتل کیږي.

in_english.name: Riswana
in_english.meaning: A name indicating dignity and honor in Islamic relations
in_english.long_meaning: Riswana is derived from the Arabic root 'r-s-w', which conveys meanings of dignity, honor, and prestige. In Islamic tradition, this name is used for individuals who are regarded with respect and admiration in their community. The name signifies qualities such as nobility and high esteem. Etymologically, it connects to Quranic values of maintaining personal honor and integrity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Riswana signifies a beautiful, vibrant, and colorful garden or a flower that is in full bloom. This is a welcome sight and brings around joy and delight. In Islamic culture, gardens and flowers are used as metaphors for beauty, paradise, and the abundance of God's blessings. Therefore, the name Riswana holds a deep sense of cultural significance as it represents the blessings and bounty of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Riswana also holds a significant spiritual meaning in Islam. It is believed that every soul is like a seed in the earth, and with the nurturing and guidance of Allah, that seed will bloom and become a beautiful and radiant flower. The name Riswana signifies the journey of a soul towards Allah, the gardener, who nurtures and cares for it until it blossoms and reaches its full potential, allowing the person to experience the divine beauty of the Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Garden, bloom" symbolizes A blooming garden or blooming flowers. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Riswana serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of garden, bloom.
